name: web-dark-grid-lines-agentic-dashboard-landing
title: Dark Blueprint Landing with Dashboard Preview
whatItIs: A dark charcoal landing page with a large striped-circle logo beside the headline 'Agentic TPM', outlined and solid blue buttons, thin vertical guide lines framing the page, a dashboard preview inside a window frame and mono-type labels.
whatItMeans: Hairline rules and monospace labels give a technical, engineered feel, like a blueprint, while the single blue accent stays confident and focused.
techniques: Visible hairline column guides framing the content
Blue filled CTA next to an outlined ghost CTA
Monospace uppercase labels for a technical voice
Dashboard shown in a window frame that is cut off at the bottom
Logo strip labeled 'Built by team from' for credibility
bestFor: B2B software with a serious tone

vocabulary.definition: Visible thin lines that expose the layout grid as decoration.
A button with only an outline and no fill.
Small uppercase monospace text used as a technical caption.
